title: InSight EDR / single-frame RDR filename
reference: InSight Camera EDR / RDR Data Products SIS (JPL D-33231, v3.4), §4.3.1

segments.label: Stereo ID
segments.description: Which stereo pair the image belongs to, so partners can be matched.

patterns.meaning: Mono image, not part of a stereo pair
Commanded stereo pair {number}; the partner carries the same ID
Ground-matched stereo pair "{value}" (the letter marks a pairing made on the ground, not when commanded)

segments.label: Eye
segments.description: Which eye the image serves as in stereo processing — an assigned role, since InSight has a single IDC.

values.X: Mixed — several mono images composited, since InSight has no true stereo camera

segments.label: Sol
segments.description: Solar day since landing, or day of year for testbed and cruise data.

patterns.meaning: Day of year {2}, year digit "{1}" — testbed or cruise data, which always carries epoch "T"

segments.label: Epoch
segments.description: Mission phase the data came from.

values._: Surface operations, or an operational readiness test

segments.label: Spacecraft clock
segments.description: Spacecraft clock count at the time the image was acquired.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: What the image holds. "EDR" is the first-order product; every other code is an RDR derived from it.

segments.label: Linearization
segments.description: Whether camera distortion was removed against the stereo partner.

values._: Non-linearized (raw geometry) — the case for all EDRs and almost all InSight RDRs

segments.label: Filter / colour
segments.description: Colour space of the product, and which band of it this file holds.

values._: Raw Bayer pattern, or grayscale if the colour was removed
values.T: XYZ colour space, all three bands
values.C: xyY colour space, all three bands
values.P: HSI colour space, all three bands

segments.label: Mesh ID
segments.description: Which terrain mesh or DEM the image contributes to; images are gathered into a mesh by matching this.

patterns.meaning: Not part of any mesh or DEM
Mesh {number}, an ID reused across sols so it only matches within one sol

segments.label: Mosaic ID
segments.description: Which mosaic the image contributes to.

patterns.meaning: Mosaic {number}, an ID reused across sols so it only matches within one sol

segments.label: Special processing
segments.description: Marks off-nominal or special processing of an RDR; always "_" on EDRs.

patterns.meaning: Special processing "{value}" — an off-nominal treatment defined for the sols it was used on and listed in the archive's special-processing text file

segments.label: Sequence ID
segments.description: Command sequence the image was acquired from; must match for stereo pairs and for auto-generated meshes and mosaics.

patterns.meaning: Ground-assigned sequence "{value}", which allows pairings the uplink team did not anticipate

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Increments whenever an otherwise identical filename would be produced.

values.TXT: ASCII file, such as a tau report
values.rgb: Terrain mesh skin in SGI RGB
values.obj: Terrain mesh in Wavefront OBJ format
values.mtl: Wavefront materials file for an OBJ mesh
